calls_locked.name: calls_locked
calls_locked.value: ("calls"."status" = 'locked') = ("calls"."locked_price" IS NOT NULL AND "calls"."tick_id" IS NOT NULL AND "calls"."locked_at" IS NOT NULL)

calls_via.name: calls_via
calls_via.value: ("calls"."via" IS NULL) = ("calls"."via_user_id" IS NULL) AND ("calls"."via" IS NULL OR "calls"."via" IN ('tail', 'fade'))

city_markets_headcount.name: city_markets_headcount
city_markets_headcount.value: "city_markets"."kind" <> 'headcount' OR ("city_markets"."place" IS NOT NULL AND "city_markets"."threshold" > 0 AND "city_markets"."measure_at" IS NOT NULL)

city_positions_stake.name: city_positions_stake
city_positions_stake.value: "city_positions"."stake" >= 1 AND ("city_positions"."crew_id" IS NOT NULL OR "city_positions"."stake" <= 800) AND ("city_positions"."payout" IS NULL OR "city_positions"."payout" >= 0)

grudge_winner.name: grudge_winner
grudge_winner.value: ("grudge_matches"."status" = 'settled') = ("grudge_matches"."winner_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("grudge_matches"."winner_id" IS NULL OR "grudge_matches"."winner_id" IN ("grudge_matches"."newcomer_id", "grudge_matches"."inviter_id"))

items_paid_consistent.name: items_paid_consistent
items_paid_consistent.value: ("items"."source" = 'purchase') = ("items"."price_paid" IS NOT NULL AND "items"."tx_id" IS NOT NULL)

moderation_items_review.name: moderation_items_review
moderation_items_review.value: ("moderation_items"."reviewed_at" IS NULL) = ("moderation_items"."review" IS NULL) AND ("moderation_items"."review" IS NULL OR "moderation_items"."review" IN ('restored', 'removed'))

shifts_collected_paid.name: shifts_collected_paid
shifts_collected_paid.value: "shifts"."collected_tx" IS NULL OR "shifts"."pay" IS NOT NULL

syndicates_per_shake.name: syndicates_per_shake
syndicates_per_shake.value: ("syndicates"."city_market_id" IS NULL) = ("syndicates"."per_shake" IS NULL) AND ("syndicates"."per_shake" IS NULL OR "syndicates"."per_shake" BETWEEN 1 AND 50)

tower_moments_kind.name: tower_moments_kind
tower_moments_kind.value: ("tower_moments"."kind" = 'swing' AND "tower_moments"."from_price" IS NOT NULL AND "tower_moments"."to_price" IS NOT NULL AND "tower_moments"."outcome" IS NULL) OR ("tower_moments"."kind" = 'settled' AND "tower_moments"."outcome" IS NOT NULL AND "tower_moments"."to_price" IS NULL AND "tower_moments"."bucket" = 0)
